description: This file is a PHP source code file that manages the web interface for wireless network configuration on a gateway device. It includes PHP code for data processing and a significant amount of embedded JavaScript for client-side UI interactions. The PHP code initializes Wi-Fi parameters, renders HTML for network settings, and manages some server-side logic, while JavaScript handles dynamic UI updates, form validation, and AJAX interactions for applying configuration changes.

methods.name: check_add
methods.description: Validates device name and MAC address inputs before adding a new wireless control list entry.

methods.name: adjust_row
methods.description: Adjusts styling and numbering for table rows representing the control list.

methods.name: add_row
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table (filtering list or auto-learned list).

methods.name: del_row
methods.description: Deletes a row from a table after user confirmation.

methods.name: add_auto
methods.description: Copies an auto-learned MAC to the control list.

methods.name: save_filter
methods.description: Saves the current filtering list configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Saves Wi-Fi configuration parameters via AJAX.

methods.name: save_enable
methods.description: Saves the enabled/disabled state of Wi-Fi radios and WPS settings.

methods.name: pair_client
methods.description: Initiates WPS pairing process via AJAX.

methods.name: pair_cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing process via AJAX.

methods.name: showSteeringHistoryDialog
methods.description: Displays the band steering history in a dialog.

methods.name: steering_history
methods.description: Fetches and displays band steering history data.

methods.name: saveBandSteeringSettings
methods.description: Saves band steering configuration parameters via AJAX.
